explanation: For λ>0, y=A sin(4λx)+B cos(4λx). The condition y'(0)=0 forces A=0, and y'(π)=0 requires sin(4λπ)=0. Thus λ_n=n/4 and y_n(x)=B_n cos(4λ_n x). The zero parameter also admits nonzero constant eigenfunctions, represented by n=0; positive integers give the positive parameters. Eigenfunctions require B_n≠0.
